purpose: Teach: 硫黄/料亭/銅像/寒天/紋章/紫色/食肉/露店

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんと硫黄温泉に泊まったぞ
lines.en: When I was young, Dad took me to a sulfur spring once.
lines.style: Soft, reaching backward into memory. Slow cadence, searching. Gentle wonder in the voice, like the warmth of the spring itself. Not wistful—certain.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、お祝いに料亭にお連れ下さったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Oh yes, and Grandpa took me to that lovely restaurant for the celebration, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Bright affirmation with a small laugh underneath. Warm, conversational, speaking more to herself than correcting him. The ease of decades together.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんは公園の銅像をご紹介下さったぞ
lines.en: When I was young, Dad showed me the bronze statue in the park.
lines.style: Same gentle reaching backward. Slightly quieter than before, as if following her thread. Tender precision—he's remembering alongside her now.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、夏に寒天ゼリーを作ってらしたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And Grandpa used to make that agar jelly in the summer, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Playful, almost conspiratorial. She's gently steering him, but with love. A small smile in the voice. Not correcting—completing.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが我が家の紋章を教えて下さったぞ
lines.en: When I was young, Dad taught me about our family emblem.
lines.style: Voice quieter, more intimate. The weight of family history in the words. Waiting for her to meet him there, patient as stone.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、紫色の着物がお好きだったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And Grandpa loved wearing that purple kimono, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Tender, almost singing the words. She's fully in her own reverie now, gently distant. A private warmth in her voice.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんは食肉を控える運動に賛同された
lines.en: When I was young, Dad supported the movement to reduce meat consumption.
lines.style: Voice steady, a little slower. Pride underneath—in his father's principle. Still reaching, but anchored now.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、お祭りの露店でりんご飴買って下さったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And Grandpa bought me candy apples at the festival stalls, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Soft fade on 'dear'—trailing off into her own memory. Warm and present, but pulling away gently. The closing breath of a conversation with ghosts.
